story_title: From Assistance to Execution: How Enterprises Put AI to Work
caption:
Enterprise AI is shifting from assistant to executioner. According to new research from OpenAI, frontier firms are moving beyond simple ChatGPT prompts and connecting models like Codex directly into internal systems to execute workflows autonomously. The real moat isn't just having access to smart AI—it's giving AI the system access required to take action.

Read the breakdown above. What workflows is your company delegating to agents this year?
